summary.headline: Saturn’s Combustion and Effects
summary.text: Astrological discussion of combustion and being under the rays, comparing Mercury and Saturn with the other planets and using material analogies for their effects. Saturn’s combustion is said to last up to a year and to bring illness to kings, calamity to elders, political disorder, tyranny, chronic disease, agricultural delay, famine, weather changes, and corruption of fruits; its effects in the fiery triplicity concern eastern rulers, coinage, agriculture, disease, drought, and mines.
